background.description: Warm sandy-yellow ground behind the house scene and the lower text area
background.rebuild_notes: Flat warm sand colour with a soft lighter patch near the lower middle; no printed text. Bottom-middle is a pale grey-white street, which is part of the scene picture i3 and the top scene i1, not the background

images.description: Isometric 3D cutaway of a family house: several rooms with beds, a pink desk and chair, a green wardrobe, a wooden dining table with six chairs, a bathroom toilet, rugs and blue-grey walls, seen from above
images.purpose: Full-page scene that sets the story setting above the title
images.style: photo-like 3D render, soft shading, no outlines, soft shadows on the floor
images.rebuild_notes: Bottom edge is cut at the top of the grey label box, so the lower rooms and street continue in i3 and the lower-left rooms are cut through. Contains the pink desk, green wardrobe, dining set and bed pieces, all part of this one scene (no separate pictures cropped from it)

images.description: Semi-transparent dark grey rectangle with the English word Working printed in large black serif letters across it
images.purpose: Label box that holds the English heading over the scene
images.style: flat grey, about 50% opacity, sharp corners, no outline
images.rebuild_notes: The word Working is printed on this box and is text (heading t1), not part of the picture; it is included in the crop only because it sits on the box. Box edges are estimated by eye. Behind the box the scene shows through

images.description: Right-hand part of the house scene: the lower-right bedroom with a bed with a red blanket and a rug, a green sofa, and a pale grey-white street running diagonally
images.purpose: Continues the house scene down the right edge
images.rebuild_notes: Cut along a vertical line at x 2050; the lighter street and wall in the middle of the page (x 1100 to 2050) are not cropped and stay in the background/scene, so this crop is only the right edge. Contains a bed and a sofa that are part of this scene

images.description: Cluster of pink flowering shrubs with dark green leaves at the left edge
images.purpose: Decorates the lower-left corner beside the text
images.rebuild_notes: Several dozen small pink blossoms on dark green bushes, in a loose cluster

images.description: Green grass lawn patch at the left edge of the ground
images.rebuild_notes: Solid green lawn with a straight right edge and a rounded bottom edge

doubts: i1 and i3 are cut through rooms and the street at the edges, so the scene is in several pieces; box edges are estimated by eye
i2 box edges are estimated; the word Working is printed on the box (t1), so the crop contains text
background colour is a guess from the sand colour; the street at the middle is not cropped and may need a separate picture or a redraw
the lower-middle and bottom sand area is plain background; no separate crop was made
